exposure: Pulsed-wave Doppler (PWD) blood flow spectral parameters (Peak systolic velocity (PSV), End-diastolic velocity (EDV))
cohort: The study included 73 women who had vaginal deliveries with epidural labor analgesia.
finding: Regional blood flow spectral parameters, specifically the change in peak systolic velocity and end-diastolic velocity 30 minutes after epidural analgesia induction, can predict the occurrence of epidural-related maternal fever.
